question: Define Iterator. How is it used in a Collection?
answerMd:
### Iterator vs. ListIterator in Java

| Comparison Parameter | `Iterator` | `ListIterator` |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Applicability** | Traverses **any Collection** (List, Set, Queue).| Traverses **List collections only** (ArrayList, LinkedList). |
| **Direction** | **Forward only** (`hasNext()`, `next()`). | **Bidirectional** (Forward & Backward). |
| **Modification Methods** | Can only **remove** elements (`remove()`). | Can **remove**, **set (replace)**, and **add** elements. |
| **Index Access** | Cannot retrieve index. | Provides `nextIndex()` and `previousIndex()`. |

$$\therefore \text{ListIterator enables full bidirectional traversal and in-place element mutation on lists.}$$
